scripts.build: pnpm run build:design-system && pnpm run build:control-plane && pnpm run build:workbench
scripts.build:design-system: pnpm --filter @dataground/tokens build && pnpm --filter @dataground/ui build && pnpm --filter @dataground/patterns build && pnpm --filter @dataground/ui storybook:build
scripts.format: biome check --write apps packages contracts scripts package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json && gofmt -w cmd internal
scripts.format:check: biome format apps packages contracts scripts package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json && node scripts/check-go-format.mjs
scripts.lint: biome lint apps packages contracts scripts package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json && go vet ./...
scripts.test: node scripts/run-go-tests.mjs && pnpm run test:tools && pnpm --filter @dataground/tokens test && pnpm --filter @dataground/ui test && pnpm --filter @dataground/patterns test && pnpm --filter @dataground/ui test:stories && pnpm --filter @dataground/workbench test && pnpm --filter @dataground/workbench test:browser
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @dataground/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @dataground/patterns typecheck && pnpm --filter @dataground/workbench typecheck
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run contracts:check && pnpm run contracts:generate:check && pnpm run openshell:profile:check && pnpm run openshell:credential-evidence:check --self-test && pnpm run openshell:credential-evidence:accepted:check && pnpm run openshell:runtime-evidence:check --self-test && pnpm run openshell:runtime-certification:check --self-test && pnpm run s3:profile:check && pnpm run tokens:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
